fine_lines.title: check vs make sure
fine_lines.explanation_ar: check يعني أن تنظر وتفحص لتعرف إن كان الشيء صحيحًا. make sure يعني أن تتأكد أو تضمن أن الشيء صحيح. بعد make sure نستخدم that + جملة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Check" = look to find out if it is correct. "Make sure" = be certain, or make it correct. Use "make sure (that) + sentence".

examples.sentence: Make sure that the door is locked.

fine_lines.title: clear vs clarify
fine_lines.explanation_ar: clear صفة بمعنى واضح، وclarify فعل بمعنى يوضّح (يجعل الشيء واضحًا).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Clear" is an adjective (easy to understand). "Clarify" is a verb (to make clear).

expressions.phrase: I just want to make sure that...
expressions.meaning_ar: أريد فقط أن أتأكد من أن...
expressions.meaning_en: Politely check that something is right.
expressions.example: I just want to make sure that the order is for 500, not 5,000.

expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك من فضلك أن توضّح...؟
expressions.example: Could you possibly clarify the delivery date?

expressions.meaning_en: A soft way to start a question.
expressions.example: I just want to check what time the meeting starts.

expressions.meaning_en: Check one detail so there is no mistake.
expressions.example: Just to be absolutely clear, you need it by Monday?

expressions.phrase: One thing I wasn't sure of was...
expressions.meaning_ar: الشيء الوحيد الذي لم أكن متأكدًا منه هو...
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about something you don't understand.
expressions.example: One thing I wasn't sure of was the price.

expressions.meaning_en: Use it before you ask a busy person something.
expressions.example: Sorry to bother you, but could I ask a quick question?

expressions.meaning_en: Say you are noting the information.
expressions.example: Fifteen mangos? OK, I'll just write that down.

grammar.title: Softening with "just" and "possibly"
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف just وpossibly لنجعل السؤال أو الطلب ألطف وأقل مباشرة: I just want to check... / Could you possibly clarify...? just تأتي قبل الفعل، وpossibly بعد could you.
grammar.explanation_en: Add "just" and "possibly" to make questions softer and more polite. "Just" goes before the verb; "possibly" goes after "could you".
examples: I just want to check the date.
Could you possibly clarify the price?
I just need one more minute.

grammar.title: Indirect questions
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد Could you clarify... أو I want to check... نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية لا ترتيب السؤال: Could you clarify what went out today? (وليس what did go out).
grammar.explanation_en: After "Could you clarify..." or "I want to check..." use normal sentence word order, not question order.
examples: Could you clarify what went out today?
I want to check what was sent to the client.
Could you tell me when the delivery arrived?

questions.question: I just want to make ___ that the order is correct.
Could you possibly ___ what went out today?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد could you نستخدم الفعل clarify.

questions.question: Just to be ___ clear, you sent the soft mangos?
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الظرف absolutely قبل الصفة clear.
questions.explanation_en: Use the adverb "absolutely" before the adjective.

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect question.
choices: Could you tell me what did you send?
Could you tell me what you sent?

questions.explanation_ar: في السؤال غير المباشر نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية.
questions.explanation_en: Indirect questions use normal word order.
